metadata.description: Flux Point Studios engineering harness: fluxpoint unifies Loop Engineering (deterministic Definition-of-Done gate on one agent's cycle) and Graph Engineering (compiler-verified multi-agent campaigns) behind one work-state file and one Evidence discipline.

plugins.name: fluxpoint
plugins.description: Engineering harness with two drivers over one contract: a Stop-hook Definition-of-Done gate with per-edit verification and session bootstrap, plus a deterministic compiler that turns a declarative WORK.md graph IR into verified multi-agent campaigns — typed contracts, verification tiers, no self-certifying mutators, provenance-recorded evidence.

plugins.name: substrate
plugins.description: Multi-repo primitive registry: per-repo substrate.json manifests compiled by a zero-dependency generator into one SUBSTRATE.md graph — nodes, consumes-edges, orphans as dormant value, hubs to harden first — with staleness alarms injected at every session start so new work plugs into existing primitives instead of running parallel to them.
